decisive_items: She had been diagnosed with a tenosynovial giant cell tumor by MRI at a local hospital
post-contrast images demonstrated homogeneous enhancement of the tendons and synovial membrane, supporting synovial hyperplasia
diffusion-weighted imaging and ADC maps suggested restricted diffusion
response.rationale: Prior MRI diagnosis of tenosynovial giant cell tumor, progressive symptoms, and imaging showing synovial/tendon enhancement with restricted diffusion favor a neoplastic process over pure inflammation or degeneration. Normal inflammatory markers and lack of systemic features further support tumor over tenosynovitis or arthritis.

rejected.why: Tenosynovitis is a preliminary diagnosis but lacks specific neoplastic features; normal inflammatory markers and restricted diffusion are more consistent with tumor.
Degenerative arthritis only explains carpal bone changes, not the prominent tendon/synovial enhancement and restricted diffusion.
